text: Exhibition Place employee recognized by the Board for recent outstanding accomplishment: 1. 2025 United Way City of Toronto Campaign Each year, to build a better city, the City of Toronto Public Service Staff, along with all Agencies, Boards, and Commissions participate in the annual city-wide fundraising program in support of United Way Toronto and York Region campaigns. Exhibition Place raised a grand total of $1,017.35 for the United Way of Toronto Campaign. In 2025 we focused our efforts on Old Technology Sales and the annual Ghost Walk Program. Over the last 21 years Exhibition Place has contributed $101,785.78 to the United Way Toronto and York Region campaigns. 2. 2025 Community Events Program Exhibition Place ran a collection of low-cost community events, where attendees would pay what they can to attend these events during the spring and summer months. The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Applauded and extended congratulations to Ms. Catherine de Nobriga for her outstanding efforts on the 2025 United Way City of Toronto Campaign and the 2025 Community Events Program.
